messages:
Samir (AE): Orchard wants a short presales POC next week. Core asks: streaming invoice ingestion, tool/function calls for parsing & enrichment, and strict JSON schema output they can drop into their ETL. Can we summarize: python SDK snippet, recommended stream mode (SSE/WebSocket), backpressure/retry guidance, auth pattern (ephemeral creds + optional VPC peering), and a pricing ballpark for ~1M tokens/mo?
Tanya (SE): I can own the 10–15m runbook. @Ira can you paste a tiny Python streaming + tool-call example (different from our usual Node examples) and preferred defaults? Also note anything infra needs for VPC peering.
Ira (SDK): Sure — short python example below. For this workload SSE is fine unless they need server-initiated control messages.
Ira (SDK): ```py
# minimal Redwood Python streaming example
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
for event in client.stream(model='redwood-chat-1', mode='sse'):
    # events may be partial deltas or final JSON; handle gracefully
    try:
        obj = json.loads(event)
        print(obj)
    except Exception:
        pass
# tool call envelope example: {'type':'tool_call','tool':'invoice_parser','input':{'text':'...'}}
```
Ira (SDK): Defaults: batch_size=6, token_window=512. If they need <300ms p99 go to batch_size=1 and enable prefix/KV caching. For very high concurrency recommend reserved capacity (dedicated pools).
Vik (Solutions): Pricing ballpark for ~1M tokens/mo: hosted gen-heavy workload ~$700/mo. If they want reserved GPUs add ~$6k–$10k/mo depending on shape (A10G vs inference-optimized A2). Embedding/dup token workloads may shift numbers. Finance to confirm.
Samir (AE): Good. They asked about backpressure and retries: they will push 200 concurrent small docs. What's our recommended client-side pattern?
Ira (SDK): For many concurrent short streams: multiplex on fewer persistent connections when possible, use client-side queuing with concurrency limit, implement exponential backoff on 429/503, and include idempotency keys for function/tool calls so retries are safe. We'll include a sample retry decorator in the runbook.
Lena (Security): Orchard requires SAML + SCIM provisioning and EU data residency for invoices. For POC we can provision ephemeral scoped creds + IP allowlist to staging. They also want an auditable stream with 7y retention; that's an enterprise ask — we can demo scoped audit exports to their S3 during POC but legal/contract needed for retention.
Tanya (SE): Noted. I'll include an appendix: 1) ephemeral creds & short TTL sample, 2) IP allowlist instructions, 3) VPC peering checklist (route table updates, TLS, NAT).
InfraBot: VPC peering template created: https://infra.internal/templates/vpc-peering-orchard (ephemeral). Peering requires a /29 free in their VPC and inbound security rule from our egress IP range.
Samir (AE): Can we get a staging instance and ephemeral creds for demo by Monday? Also request a tiny preflight validator so customer can validate model output against JSON schema before ingest.
Ira (SDK): We'll add a small JSON Schema example and a preflight validator snippet that rejects/normalizes fields (dates -> ISO, numbers coerced). That reduces brittle mappings.
Vik (Solutions): I'll prepare a one-pager comparing hosted vs reserved vs private (latency, cost, security), and call out the A10G vs A2 cost tradeoffs.
Lena (Security): I'll draft the security appendix (SSO/SCIM/KMS/retention) and note the need for a DPA amendment for long-term audit retention.
Samir (AE): Great — team, please upload runbook + one-pager + security appendix before EOD so I can send to the customer. :rocket:
Tanya (SE): Will do. I'll link the runbook to the kickoff invite once uploaded.
Ira (SDK): Uploaded python sample + retry decorator to runbook.
Lena (Security): Security appendix uploaded.
Vik (Solutions): Pricing slide + tradeoffs uploaded.
InfraBot: Staging deployed: orchard-poc-staging at https://staging.orchard.redwood — ephemeral creds emailed to samir@orchard.com (valid 24h).
Samir (AE): Thanks all, will confirm kickoff time with Orchard.
